description: This file defines classes and methods related to managing undo/redo history in an application, including HistoryDelta, HistoryChangedEvent, and History classes, with methods for applying, inverting, recording, undoing, and redoing state changes.

classes.name: HistoryDelta
classes.description: Represents a delta (change) in the history, extending StoreDelta, with methods to apply changes, calculate, invert, and apply latest changes.

classes.name: HistoryChangedEvent
classes.description: Event class indicating the state of undo and redo stacks.

classes.name: History
classes.description: Manages undo and redo stacks, emits change events, and provides methods to record changes, undo, and redo.

methods.name: applyTo
methods.description: Applies the delta to elements and appState, returning updated states and whether visible changes occurred.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the delta between two snapshots, overridden to return a HistoryDelta.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Returns the inverse of a given delta, overridden to return a HistoryDelta.

methods.name: applyLatestChanges
methods.description: Applies the latest changes to a delta, overridden to return a HistoryDelta.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a new change into the undo stack, clearing redo stack if necessary.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Performs an undo operation, restoring previous state.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Performs a redo operation, restoring next state.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Internal method to perform undo or redo actions, managing stacks and applying changes.
